articles.title: New UK Election Funding Rules Could Hit Reform's Crypto Billionaire Donors
articles.snippet: The crackdown on overseas cash comes after billionaire Tether investor and Reform donor Christopher Harborne registered to vote in the UK.

articles.title: Robinhood Launches 'AI-Native' Ethereum Layer-2 Network, Tokenized Stock Trading
articles.snippet: Brokerage and crypto exchange Robinhood opened the public mainnet for its Arbitrum-powered Ethereum layer-2 network on Wednesday.
